entries.summary: Initial build: CSV import, WP account creation with Convention Attendee role, year-over-year tracking, welcome email
entries.notes: New plugin. DB table wp_oha_attendees (unique key email+year). Convention Attendee role (oha_convention_attendee, read-only). JEmail integration via WP role filter - no JEmail code changes needed. Welcome email body stored with wp_unslash only (no stripping) to preserve special chars. Batched send via AJAX loop (25/batch). merge tags: first_name, last_name, email, username, year, ticket_level, add_ons, purchase_amount, set_password_link, site_name, site_url. set_password_link only outputs for newly created accounts.

entries.summary: Set _uwp_register_form_id=4 on import to prevent UWP defaulting new attendee accounts to form 1 (OHA Member)
entries.notes: UsersWP uwp_get_register_form_id() returns 1 when meta is absent, causing imported accounts to appear as OHA Members. Fix: update_user_meta _uwp_register_form_id immediately after wp_insert_user. Form ID is configurable in Settings (option oha_attendee_uwp_form_id, default 4).

entries.summary: Add UsersWP Form ID setting to Settings page so the UWP form assigned on import is configurable
entries.notes: Option: oha_attendee_uwp_form_id. Default 4. Shown in Attendee Hub > Settings with instructions to verify in UsersWP > User Types.

entries.summary: Add ticket type and add-on filter dropdowns to attendee list page with Clear button
entries.notes: Dropdowns populate dynamically from distinct DB values for the selected year. Add-on filter uses LIKE query since multiple add-ons are stored comma-separated. Filters persist in URL for bookmarking.

entries.summary: Add Stats page with summary cards, ticket type breakdown, add-on breakdown, and state breakdown
entries.notes: Revenue computed in PHP by stripping non-numeric chars from purchase_amount string. Ticket and add-on rows link directly to filtered attendee list. Stats submenu added between Welcome Email and Settings.

entries.summary: Fix import grouping so multiple CSV rows per email merge add-ons into one comma-separated record
entries.notes: group_by_email() pre-processes raw rows before import/preview. Duplicate add-ons for same email are deduplicated. Preview now shows Add-Ons column and raw row vs attendee count.

entries.summary: Added wp_oha_attendee_addons table with one row per add-on per attendee, including individual amounts
entries.notes: attendee_id FK to wp_oha_attendees.id; amount decimal(8,2); year+email duplicated for fast roster queries; idempotent on re-import via delete+reinsert

entries.summary: Added Roster admin page showing per-add-on attendance lists for instructors
entries.notes: Page slug oha-attendee-roster; shows name, email, ticket level, amount, included-in-ticket badge; only populated for records imported with v1.1.0+; stats page addon rows link to roster

entries.summary: Rewrote group_by_email() to separate ticket rows (blank add-on col) from add-on rows
entries.notes: Ticket row = CSV row where COL_ADDON is blank; add-on rows = non-blank; if no blank row exists first row used as ticket row; main record gets comma-sep summary for display; importer stores full per-addon data in new table

entries.summary: Fixed fatal PHP parse error where page_stats was declared inside page_settings method body
entries.notes: Previous class-attendee-admin.php had duplicate page_settings and page_stats nested inside another method - both PHP syntax errors; file fully rewritten with correct structure

entries.summary: Renamed import preview stat cards to action verbs: Creating new accounts / Updating existing accounts
entries.notes: Was New accounts / Existing accounts -- ambiguous whether existing would be skipped or updated

entries.summary: Added per-year gate sales field on Stats page to record walk-up ticket counts not in CSV
entries.notes: Stored as WP option oha_attendee_gate_sales_{year}; saved via AJAX; Stats page shows Online (CSV) / Gate Sales / Combined Total cards; ticket/addon % columns labeled as % of Online to clarify they exclude gate sales; combined total available for future chart use

entries.summary: Added Gate Sales input to Stats page for walk-up ticket counts not in CSV
entries.notes: Saved as WP option oha_attendee_gate_sales_{year}. Stats page shows Online/Gate/Combined Total cards.

entries.summary: Added Unit Prices settings and Implied Tickets column on Stats page
entries.notes: Unit prices stored as oha_attendee_unit_prices option (name=>float). Implied = revenue / unit_price. Matches venue-reported ticket counts.

entries.summary: Relabeled ticket/add-on stat columns from Count to Buyers to clarify % of Online excludes gate sales
entries.notes: Stats table headers updated for clarity.

entries.summary: Relabeled import preview stat cards to Creating new accounts / Updating existing accounts
entries.notes: Previous labels New accounts / Existing accounts were ambiguous during re-import.
